race.description: Hertz Year Of The Horse Sprint Hcp (Bm74)
race.comment: They'll fly along in this. I'M FOXING (6) finds her right race. She's been outclassed in two runs back but wasn't beaten far in the Century Stakes at Flemington behind Rey Magnerio and now comes back to a BM74 around her home track. She should jump and land outside lead and will go close. MAINMANKASH (3) is a very fast horse, too slick in a 955m here last time. SALUTED (9) will find this easier than the Doveton last week and can bounce back, her 1000m record reads well. CHOIR POINT (10) can run well fresh and is in the minor mix. Have liked the winning trials on the way into this and clearly forward enough to give a good account of himself.
